mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and nephrotoxicity; doxycycline is renally cleared and can accumulate with renal impairment, while both drugs may increase esophageal irritation risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and calcium levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotic if severe renal impairment develops; separate dosing times and maintain good esophageal transit.
